_about: Johanna Spyri's (1827-1901) Swiss stories, in English translations whose translators are named: Heidi in two translations, the translation the Gutenberg header credits to Marion Edwards (PG 1448; the name is usually given as Marian Edwardes) and Elisabeth P. Stork's (PG 20781, 1915), so the shelf carries two witnesses of one book; Moni the Goat-Boy tr. Helen B. Dole; Rico and Wiseli tr. Louise Brooks. Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).

spyri-moni-the-goat-boy: Moni the Goat-Boy, tr. Helen B. Dole
spyri-rico-and-wiseli: Rico and Wiseli, tr. Louise Brooks

_excluded.spyri-heidi-abbott: Heidi tr. Mabel Abbott (PG 46409, 1927): a third translation of the same book; US public domain, held back only to keep the shelf small
_excluded.spyri-other: her other translated stories (Toni, Veronica, Gritli's Children, Maezli, Vinzi, Dora and others, each with its translator named in the catalog): candidates for a later batch
